safe_session_sweepable.gpu-memory-utilization: Session-level memory allocation bound for vLLM executor.
safe_session_sweepable.max-model-len: Session-level context length bound already used by existing sweeps.
safe_session_sweepable.performance-mode: Session-level vLLM performance profile already used by existing sweeps.
safe_session_sweepable.max-num-batched-tokens: Scheduler token budget; performance-relevant and session-local.
safe_session_sweepable.max-num-seqs: Scheduler sequence budget; performance-relevant and session-local.

session_risky.kv-cache-dtype: Can alter memory use and numerical behavior; needs focused validation.
session_risky.block-size: Can affect allocator behavior; needs focused validation.
session_risky.swap-space: Can involve host memory and latency trade-offs.
session_risky.cpu-offload-gb: Can move memory pressure to host RAM and affect stability.
session_risky.enforce-eager: Changes execution mode and CUDA graph behavior.
session_risky.speculative-model: Requires additional model selection and quality validation.
session_risky.num-speculative-tokens: Speculative decoding depends on draft model behavior.
session_risky.tensor-parallel-size: Topology-sensitive and not useful without explicit GPU topology spec.
session_risky.pipeline-parallel-size: Topology-sensitive and out of scope for single-node small sweeps.

persistent_or_system_blocked.download-dir: Can alter cache paths and storage behavior.
persistent_or_system_blocked.tokenizer-mode: Not a performance knob for the current safe sweep scope.
